findings.problem: `hyϖ` (lines 258–268) and `hz₀` (lines 286–294) prove the same equivalence in opposite directions, each by a hand-written 8–10 line argument. The equivalence is that the germ of the image of the uniformizer is in the maximal ideal of the stalk exactly when `algebraMap A (chartAlgFin …) ϖ ∈ y.asIdeal`. Both do `subst hy`, obtain the stalk iso `ey` and `hey1`, rewrite `hey1 ϖ` with the germ equation, transport `IsUnit` along `ey` via `BCAsm.isUnit_iff_of_iso`, and finish with `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply` and `IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff`. The two copies are written in different styles: one uses a `hnu`/`hmem` forward chain, the other a long `rw` chain with `mpr`. That makes the shared structure hard to see, and a change to the stalk-iso API would have to be made twice. The same iso-and-unit-transport pattern also recurs at lines 388–394 and 456–461.
findings.proposed_change: Prove the iff once, in the `BCAsm` namespace or beside `exists_stalk_iso_localization_chartAlgFin`, for arbitrary data. The statement: `lemma germ_uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra R F] (j : F) [Fact (j ≠ 0)] (y : XFin R F j) (r : R) (z) (hy : (ιFin R F j).base y = z) (rz) (hrz : rz = (presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial).hom ((toBase R F j).appTop.hom ((ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom r))) : rz ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (presheaf.stalk z) ↔ algebraMap R (chartAlgFin R F j) r ∈ y.asIdeal`. Proof sketch: `subst hy`, take `ey, hey1` from `exists_stalk_iso_localization_chartAlgFin`, rewrite `hey1 r` with `hrz`, apply `IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal`, `mem_nonunits_iff` and `BCAsm.isUnit_iff_of_iso ey`, then `IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply` and `IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff`. Then `hyϖ := (germ_uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal_iff A (↥K) j y ϖ _ hy ϖz hϖz).mp hz` and `hz₀ := (germ_uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal_iff A₀ (↥K₀) j₀ y₀ ϖ₀ _ hy₀ ϖz₀ hϖz₀).mpr hy₀ϖ`. Optionally also factor the `IsUnit` transport at lines 456–461 into a lemma `isUnit_germ_iff` stated for general `a` on the same pattern.
findings.benefit: About 20 lines of duplicated, differently-styled stalk/localization reasoning become one named lemma with two one-line uses. The mathematical content (maximal ideal of the stalk corresponds to the prime `y` of the chart ring) is stated once and is checkable at a glance. Future changes to the stalk-iso API need one edit, and the lemma is reusable by other files that need the same transport.
